headline: Sinner beats Zverev in four: two tiebreaks, then the champion's weight
whyCareReason: Second straight Wimbledon, fifth major. Zverev had just won Roland Garros. Grass still belonged to Sinner.
teaser: Jannik Sinner def. Alexander Zverev 6-7 (7-9), 7-6 (7-2), 6-3, 6-4. Championship point on a 23-shot rally.
story:
Why this one matters: Alexander Zverev arrived as the reigning French Open champion, looking for a Channel Slam. Jannik Sinner arrived as world No. 1, looking for a second straight Wimbledon and a first major of 2026 after an Australian Open semi loss to Djokovic and a French Open second-round exit with heat exhaustion.

The score, from CBS: 6-7 (7-9), 7-6 (7-2), 6-3, 6-4. First break of the match at 5-3 in the third. Championship point after a 23-shot rally, Sinner's forehand. He now has 100 major match wins.

The first two sets were serve. The last two were the favourite remembering who he is.
stakes: A fifth Slam versus Zverev's first Wimbledon final.
rivalryAngle: The two biggest first-strike games in men's tennis, on grass.
